answer: In an agent marketplace trading walnut harvests, each bidding identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before receiving a task slot. Creating mirror identities therefore requires fresh collateral rather than just fresh keys: 1,000 sybils immobilize $100,000 for a month. A fixed slot limit per bond makes fake-account growth spiral into a proportional capital and financing bill, so multiplying identities cannot multiply access for free.
